boundary.writeGate: configure() raises _StagingOwnershipUnproven before the first credential write when the descriptor-to-entry binding cannot be established.
boundary.publicationGate: The trusted-parent precondition is re-verified, the ownership evidence is re-derived, the pre-rename binding is re-checked, and the pinned directory is required to hold exactly the entries this run acquired with each of them still resolving to the file identity it was acquired under - immediately before the exclusive no-replace rename. A directory that cannot be enumerated is refused rather than published on the strength of its inode alone.
boundary.rollback: Exact-owned: only acquired file identities are unlinked, and the directory is rmdir'd only while it is still the proven inode.
boundary.unauthenticatedWindow: The create-to-open window is not authenticated by pathname; the trusted parent (0700, current-user-owned, no additional ACL) is the precondition that excludes other principals. A same-account actor racing that window is not detectable and is not claimed.
boundary.wasPreviousState: staging_ownership_proven was hardcoded False and gated only rollback rmdir; credential writes and publication were not gated on ownership.

checks.note: 24 pre-existing tests (LocalVoiceConfigurationTests) plus 15 boundary tests (StagingPublicationBoundaryTests), each separately selectable: the legacy selector runs 24 OK and the boundary selector runs 15 OK. NOT reproducible on the Python version CI uses - on 3.12.11 and 3.13.12 the suite reports Ran 39, FAILED (failures=1), because test_cli_errors_are_sanitized_and_actionable expects the 3.14 message for a 260-character output name while 3.12/3.13 report 'Configuration path could not be inspected safely'. That fixture fails identically at baseCommit ce97e46 (Ran 24, FAILED failures=1), so it is pre-existing; no boundary fixture is affected.
checks.negativeCaseAddressed: The prior 24 passing tests did not prove the new boundary. Two of them encoded the old rollback contract and had been loosened to ValueError without disclosure; this run restores both to their exact base assertions (assertRaises(_CleanupIncomplete) and assertRaisesRegex(_CleanupIncomplete, 'manual')) by giving the generated-file privacy failures a specific type again, so the code satisfies the stricter contract instead of the assertion being relaxed to match the code. The other 22 legacy fixtures are byte-identical to baseCommit; one carries a corrected explanatory comment only, disclosed here because its old comment described the pre-fix mechanism.

checks.command: independent supervisor probe: inject a foreign entry after the last credential write and before publication; separately swap the staging directory for a different directory inside the create-to-pin window
checks.note: Against 4a3f727 the first probe published the injected entry and returned success; at 58f7445 it raised and preserved the foreign inode. The second probe, re-run against 58f7445, found the directory-payload swap publishes when the adopted directory is empty and is refused when it holds an entry this run did not create. Both branches are now pinned by fixtures; the window itself remains unauthenticated, as README states.
